thesis: Apple's ecosystem-driven Services mix keeps lifting already exceptional returns on capital, but a P/E above its own 5-year maximum limits 12-month upside, so it merits only a starter core position.
reason: Quality is exceptional and still rising, with ROIC 101.6% and gross margin 48.7% trending up. However, P/E, EV/EBITDA and EV/Sales all sit above their 5-year maxima, and regulation threatens Services economics. P/FCF within its range justifies owning it, but only at a minimum 3% size. The portfolio is all cash, so no replacement is needed.

triggers.text: Gross margin falls below 46%, implying Services mix or pricing power is breaking down.
ROIC falls below 75%, its 5-year trough, implying capital no longer compounds at the current rate.
Price closes below the 200-day MA level of 289.75, implying a de-rating without an earnings offset.
